name: correlation_stream
algorithm: streaming sliding correlation / matched filter; per-position full-precision integer sum plus per-frame earliest-tie argmax
sample_format: signed16 {im,re} packed in s_tdata[31:0]; im ignored in real mode
template_format: 1..64 signed16 {im,re} taps packed in cfg_taps[2047:0]; unused slots ignored
output: m_tdata[95:0]={im,re} per position with m_pos lag index and tuser/tlast group markers; p_pos/p_tdata/p_mag/p_error per-frame argmax summary, |re|+|im| proxy, earliest tie
rounding: none; exact integer accumulation, |acc| <= ntaps*2^31 <= 2^37 in signed48
frame_markers: s_tuser=SOF s_tlast=EOL; violations set sticky marker_error and are tolerated with documented recovery; max frame 65535 samples
configuration: atomic valid/ready at clean frame boundary only; illegal ntaps/tail/mode/conj reject the whole request; mid-frame assertion held not accepted
multiplier: two signed16x16 combinational products per serialized MAC step; real ntaps steps/output, complex 2*ntaps steps/output; no II1 claim
timing: first output rise = accept+steps+1; emit gaps steps+2 (sample) / steps+1 (tail); p_valid = last data accept + 1; sample pitch steps+2
remaining: argmax uses documented L1 |re|+|im| proxy not squared magnitude
frames above 65535 samples / FULL tails wrapping positions only flag marker_error
side-channel or streaming-rate use is unqualified
